name: sdlc-workflow
description: Reusable SDLC workflow: Jira-to-GitLab autopilot, trunk-based conventions, and review gates for AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Jira-to-MR autopilot: clarify, branch, spec, plan, build, verify, publish.
interface.longDescription: SDLC Workflow packs a jira-autopilot orchestrator skill plus an mr-review gate, Jira/GitLab trunk conventions, and lifecycle command wrappers for Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, Copilot, Kiro, Windsurf, and Antigravity. Upstream engineering skills (spec, plan, TDD, review, ship) install separately via addyosmani/agent-skills.
defaultPrompt: Take this Jira issue end to end: clarify, branch, spec, plan, build, verify, publish, open the MR
Review this MR against its Jira acceptance criteria
